$comment: TAUT catalog — MCP servers as DATA. serverKey MUST match the tool-name namespace artifacts reference (mcp__<serverKey>__*); env lists variable NAMES only — values live in each developer's .taut/local.env. Version pins are the catalog author's responsibility: verify against the upstream registry when bumping, and record the provenance in the commit message.

context7.usage: Use it PROACTIVELY: the FIRST stop for any library/framework API question (`resolve-library-id` → `query-docs`); web search is the fallback, not the default.

playwright.usage: Browser automation for VERIFICATION of frontend changes — prefer `browser_snapshot` (accessibility tree) for checks, `browser_take_screenshot` only for human-facing evidence. An observation tool, not a data-entry channel: never enter credentials or real personal data. First run may need a one-time browser download (`browser_install`).

CONTEXT7_API_KEY: Optional — higher rate limits. Create at https://context7.com/dashboard
leave empty to run without a key
